articles.title: Justin Sun seeks sanctions against Trump-linked World Liberty Financial over UAE ties
articles.snippet: The Tron founder says World Liberty failed to disclose its UAE ties until months into his lawsuit over $45 million in WLFI tokens.

articles.title: Binance's $6.3 billion hack began with a fake job interview, and a campaign 'built over many months'
articles.snippet: North Korea-linked attackers spent months compromising Binance employees and internal systems before exploiting its hot-wallet signing infrastructure through Ethereum's EIP-7702 mechanism.

articles.title: SpaceX blocks tokenized stock listing on OKXICE despite offshore trading boom
articles.snippet: SpaceX joined several other issuers objecting to OKXICE tokenized trading, months after crypto platforms offered tokens tied to its shares.

articles.title: Binance’s net inflows turn positive at $2.3B as withdrawals expand
articles.snippet: Binance led exchanges in 24-hour net inflows, reversing Monday’s heavy outflows as it restored access to funds after its $6.3 billion hack.

articles.title: Bitcoin price threatens $77.7K support loss with recent buyers underwater
articles.snippet: Bitcoin fell below the realized price of the one-to-three-month-old buyer cohort in a move that risked flipping it to new resistance.
